run_fill_template: run fill_template.py to substitute variables in a .pbtxt config file
build_config_substitution: build a substitution string in variable_name:value format for fill_template.py
test_fill_template_in_place: test fill_template.py with --in-place flag to modify .pbtxt file in place
refactor_fill_template_output: refactor fill_template.py to print substituted output instead of modifying in place
review_fill_template_participant_ids: review fill_template.py --participant_ids argument for model configuration
